description: Danmarks Fikspunktregister is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Klimadatastyrelsen. Denmark's Fixed Points Register includes physically marked points in the landscape, called fixed points, and their associated information. These fixation points make it possible to relate measurement and sales to a common national or international reference, which ensures a clear correlation between places on the map and reality. Coverage: Klimadatastyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "Denmark’s Fixed Points Register" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Klimadatastyrelsen. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
